description: Create or correct a local My Token on a Marketo Folder or Program by name and token_type, including an empty value to clear it. The same endpoint upserts existing tokens. Async form write returns the vendor envelope; RBAC controls access and concurrent updates are last-write-wins.
embedding_description: Create or correct a local My Token on a Marketo Folder or Program by name and token_type, including an empty value to clear it. The same endpoint upserts existing tokens. Async form write returns the vendor envelope; RBAC controls access and concurrent updates are last-write-wins.

result_processor_customizations.action_label: Marketo: Set Asset Token job dispatched
result_processor_customizations.result_description: Queued job_id and status. Poll check_marketo_job_status for the redacted vendor success/result/requestId/warnings envelope.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Poll the job before reporting success. Report vendor results and warnings; read back before retrying uncertain writes.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Create or correct a local My Token on a Marketo Folder or Program by name and token_type, including an empty value to clear it. The same endpoint upserts existing tokens. Async form write returns the vendor envelope; RBAC controls access and concurrent updates are last-write-wins.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: marketo.invalid_params: correct vendor-shaped inputs. marketo.permission_denied: vendor RBAC or workspace access refused. marketo.auth_failed: credential rejected. marketo.validation_failed: vendor rejected the operation. A transport failure may follow a mutation.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Use the registered credential and vendor Read-Only Assets / Read-Write Assets permissions. Reads do not prove write access. Read back state before retrying an uncertain mutation; these endpoints offer no CAS/ETag.
